body.name: I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}
body.construction:
When \(s=1\), define \(I_n^{\mathrm{SI}}=I_n^{\mathrm{SI},1}\) by def:lipschitz-scan-invert.  When \(1<s\le2\), put \(m=\lfloor n/4\rfloor\), \(H=(\kappa_n/(2^{12}M))^{1/s}\), and compute \(\widehat c_{\mathrm{prof}}\) from folds one through three by def:profile-cutoff-center.  On fold four put \(b=m^{-1/(2s+1)}\), use \(K_1(u)=(4-6u)\mathbf 1\{0\le u\le1\}\), and, for \(V\in\{D,Y\}\), define
\[
 \widehat\Delta_{4,b}^{V}(t)=\frac1{mb}\sum_{i\in F_4}V_i
 \left\{K_1\!\left(\frac{X_i-t}{b}\right)
 -K_1\!\left(\frac{t-X_i}{b}\right)\mathbf 1\{X_i<t\}\right\}.
\]
Set \(\widehat y(t)=\widehat\Delta_{4,b}^{Y}(t)\) and \(\widehat d(t)=\widehat\Delta_{4,b}^{D}(t)\).  With
\[
 R_c=\frac{2^{16}\log(32/\alpha)}{m\kappa_n^2}+\frac1n
\]
and
\[
 r_{n,\mathrm{prof}}=64\left\{Mb^s+\kappa_n\frac{R_c}{b}
 +MR_c+\lVert K_1\rVert_\infty
 \sqrt{\frac{\log(32/\alpha)}{mb}}\right\},
\]
return \(\Theta\) if the profile construction invokes a fallback, if \(R_c>H/8\), if \(r_{n,\mathrm{prof}}>\kappa_n/8\), or if \(\widehat d(\widehat c_{\mathrm{prof}})<\kappa_n/2\).  Otherwise return the connected hull of
\[
 \left\{\vartheta\in\Theta:
 |\widehat y(\widehat c_{\mathrm{prof}})-
 \vartheta\widehat d(\widehat c_{\mathrm{prof}})|
 \le2r_{n,\mathrm{prof}}\right\},
\]
with an empty accepted set replaced by the singleton containing the projected ratio.  This defines a measurable four-fold sample map.  The term \(MR_c\), which is absent from the known-cutoff rate, is retained because the stated class permits a derivative kink at \(c_P\).
